    public function __construct ( $instance_id = 0 )

            'instance-settings',
        ];

        $this->plan_cost = new Settings_Plan_Cost();

        add_action( 'woocommerce_update_options_shipping_' . $this->id, [ $this, 'process_admin_options' ] );
    }

     * Init user set variables.
     *
     * @since 1.0.0
